clue.text: One of the strings in a racket

definitions.meaning: a violin, a member of an orchestra's string section
a racket is a swindle or scam

explanation.definitionFit: A violin is colloquially named this, and a dishonest scheme or swindle is also called by the same word.

clue.text: A city girl

definitions.meaning: the Tuscan capital, Firenze in Italian
a woman's first name, as borne by Nightingale

explanation.definitionFit: The Italian city of Firenze has this English name, which is also a girl's forename made famous by Nightingale.

clue.text: To alight, boy gets up and drops

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means the word for boy is written bottom to top

parts.note: Ted is a boy's name
drops of water falling from the sky are rain

explanation.surface: A lad climbs aboard and then lets go in some sort of acrobatic stunt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets up' turns TED (the boy) into DET, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To get off a train is to alight from it, a passenger's descent at the platform.

clue.text: Change places and improve on nature

indicators.note: change tells us the letters of the next two words are to be rearranged

parts.note: fodder taken as written

explanation.surface: A gardener swaps things around to make the natural scenery better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' rearranges the nine letters of PLACES AND.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to lay out gardens and grounds artfully is improving on the natural scenery.

clue.text: Lowering boat to fish

parts.note: a scow is a flat-bottomed barge
ling is a long cod-like sea fish

explanation.surface: A boat is being lowered so the crew can go fishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lowering' looks like a boat being let down; it is the adjective meaning frowning darkly (also spelt louring).
explanation.definitionFit: A lowering look is a dark, frowning one, a synonym for a sullen glower.

clue.text: A fiery revolutionary

parts.note: not a hot-headed rebel but a firework that spins round as it burns

explanation.definitionFit: A firework pinned to a post that spins in a circle of sparks is literally fiery and revolving.

clue.text: With difficulty obtain a little sleep, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word for a little sleep is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: a rest is a short period of repose

explanation.surface: Someone struggling to get even a short nap.
explanation.definitionFit: To get something by force or effort, as when seizing power from a rival, is to wrest it.

clue.text: Without a break, he'll conclude the number

parts.note: to infer is to conclude by reasoning

explanation.surface: Someone talking non-stop who will finish by reading out the figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a joke: write he'll without its apostrophe break and you get HELL, which the answer means.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante's vision of the underworld gives this word for hell, place of fire and damnation.

clue.text: Tame maggot

definitions.meaning: an old anglers' name for a maggot used as bait

explanation.definitionFit: Docile animals are mild-mannered, and anglers once called the bluebottle larva used as bait by the same word.

clue.text: Layabout well-behaved, in vain

parts.note: a well-behaved child is good
something done in vain is done for nothing

explanation.surface: An idle person who behaves nicely but achieves nothing by it.
explanation.definitionFit: An idle, worthless person is a waster or ne'er-do-well.

clue.text: Utter two dismissals

definitions.meaning: complete, thorough, as in an utter rogue
out, and then out again, as in cricket

explanation.definitionFit: A thorough or complete villain is an utter one; and in cricket a batsman dismissed is out, so two dismissals are out twice joined by a conjunction.

clue.text: Myself, I never held with mischief

indicators.note: held tells us the answer is contained within the words Myself, I never

explanation.surface: A virtuous speaker swears never to have been mixed up in any naughtiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Impish and mischievous like a little fairy sprite of folklore.

clue.text: Pleased about having passed

indicators.note: about here means the letters of pleased are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone happy at having got through an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that has gone by has passed, as in an hour slipping away.

clue.text: Every other peanut there able to give great pleasure

indicators.note: every other letter means we take alternate letters from the following words

explanation.surface: Peanuts there are capable of being a great treat.
explanation.walkthrough: Starting from the second letter, every other letter of PEANUT THERE ABLE spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To captivate or delight someone is to hold them spellbound.

clue.text: Take steps against the state

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
GA is the abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: Acting in opposition to the government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take steps' sounds like taking action; it is to dance a line dance where people kick in procession.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to dance in a snaking line with kicks is to take dance steps.

clue.text: I'm out so I'm in so I'm left out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of so I'm in so are put out of order

explanation.surface: A child frets about being in or out of a game, and finally excluded.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue speaks as the answer: rearrange SO I'M IN SO and you get a thing that says it is left out.
explanation.definitionFit: Something neglected or excluded from a list is an exclusion, a thing left unmentioned.

clue.text: Out East our flowers disintegrate — how sad!

indicators.note: disintegrate tells us the remaining letters fall apart and are reassembled
out tells us the abbreviation for East is removed

explanation.surface: Gardeners in the East lament their blooms falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out' drops E from OUR FLOWERS, leaving OURFLOWRS, which 'disintegrate' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A mournful or grieving feeling is sad, full of sorrow.

clue.text: Characteristic of sylphs — heartless servility

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the word for servility is taken away

parts.note: sliminess is oily, fawning servility

explanation.surface: Sylph-like creatures are coldly fawning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' removes the central I of SLIMINESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sylphs are slender, graceful beings, so thinness is their characteristic.

clue.text: One bird born outside, one in captivity

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

indicators.note: outside means the word for born goes around the bird

parts.note: née marks a maiden name, meaning born
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A bird hatched in the wild contrasted with one kept caged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' wraps the word for born round the bird; 'one' appears twice, first as the numeral, then inside the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A person detained, as in a wartime camp, is held captive.

clue.text: The god to write uplifting music

indicators.note: in a down clue, uplifting means the word for write is read from the bottom up

parts.note: to pen a letter is to write it
a tune is a piece of music

explanation.surface: A deity composes music that lifts the spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman deity of the sea, counterpart of Poseidon.

clue.text: Keep at arm's length and dance round quietly

indicators.note: round means the dance word goes around the letter for quietly

parts.note: a reel is a Scottish dance
p (piano) is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A dancer keeps a partner at a distance while circling softly.
explanation.walkthrough: A REEL is a lively Scottish folk dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To ward off or drive back is to hold something at a distance.

clue.text: Hat in defensive position

explanation.definitionFit: A small round brimless hat and a small concrete gun emplacement share this name.

clue.text: Survives possibly without IV or V

indicators.note: possibly says the letters left are an arrangement of what they might be
without tells us the letters IV are taken out of survives

explanation.surface: A patient pulls through even without an intravenous drip, or a five.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes I and V from SURVIVES, leaving SURVES, which 'possibly' rearranges. V is the usual abbreviation, as in a match listing.
explanation.definitionFit: V stands for 'against', as in a fixture listing such as England v France.

clue.text: Former Middle Eastern organization- it is put to good use

parts.note: ex- means former, as in ex-wife
PLO is the Palestine Liberation Organization
taken as written

explanation.surface: A former Middle Eastern group that is now being used profitably.
explanation.definitionFit: To make full use of a resource or opportunity is to utilise it to advantage.

clue.text: Instruct society to tidy up

explanation.definitionFit: To command, a fraternity such as of monks or knights, and to arrange neatly all share this word.

clue.text: Tough outlaw, no saint in a squalid district

parts.note: Robin Hood was the outlaw, and a hood is a gangster

indicators.note: no tells us the abbreviation for saint is dropped

parts.note: a slum is a squalid area of a city

explanation.surface: A hard outlaw, far from saintly, living in a run-down area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' removes S from SLUM, leaving LUM. 'Tough' is a noun here: a thug.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent thug or gangster is a rough street criminal.

clue.text: Test depth of water in the channel

definitions.meaning: measure depth with a weighted line
a strait or narrow stretch of sea

explanation.definitionFit: Sailors measure depth with a plumb line by this verb, and a strait of sea between islands is also called by it.

clue.text: Sort of fine story that cannot be told

indicators.note: sort of signals that the letters of fine are sorted into a new order

parts.note: a fable is a story

explanation.surface: A fine tale so delicate it cannot be told.
explanation.definitionFit: Something too great or sacred to be expressed in words is unutterable.

clue.text: Cheap accommodation for a course

definitions.meaning: the cheapest passenger quarters on a ship
the act of steering, as for setting a course

explanation.definitionFit: Third-class passengers on a liner travelled in the cheapest quarters, and the act of steering a ship's course has the same name.

clue.text: Cords put round possibly female fairy

indicators.note: put round means the pieces that follow are turned back to front

parts.note: sex is male or possibly female
an elf is a fairy

explanation.surface: Ribbons wrapped around a fairy who might be a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put round' turns the whole run backwards; 'possibly female' is sex, which may be female or male, and 'Cords' are electrical leads, not ropes.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical leads connecting appliances to sockets are called this in Britain.
